captures.note: remoteineurope.com no longer exists as a board: every configured URL answers 301 to weworkremotely.com, and this is a slice of what comes back. The page has no /job/<slug> links at all - We Work Remotely uses /remote-jobs/<slug> - so the adapter's /job/<slug> regex (the adapter was removed when the board was retired in #128) matched nothing and the adapter returned 0 found with 0 errors. The harness reports this as final_url on every remoteineurope URL: the request answers 301 and fetch follows it, so the board looks like a 200 unless something compares where the response came from with where it was asked for.
